frontmatter.name: dompis-qe
frontmatter.description: Audit, diagnose, extend, and verify the Dompis QE Laravel application while preserving LOP lifecycle, location-scoped admin access, BOQ snapshots, technician evidence workflow, import queues, and production migration safety. Use for Dompis QE bug fixes, features, UI, database audits, LOP/BOQ import, evidence approval, technician mobile flow, dashboard, revenue, reporting, or deployment preparation.
